title:
"Sol y Luna"
Just outside Nashville
description:
Beautiful modern home in a quiet neighborhood but very close to Interstate 24, shopping center, movie theater, restaurants, and supermarkets.
Located 25 minutes from downtown Nashville, 20 minutes from Murfreesboro, and 20 from Nashville airport. 
Open kitchen and dining room, spacious living room with 65-inch smart TV, and laundry room with Brand New large washer/dryer. 
Loft with daybed, smart TV, chairs, and  foosball table.
Outside Covered patio with privacy fence.

The space
Self entry to the house with keypad lock. Code is generated and erased after each guest stays.
Free WiFi access from fast high speed internet, and flat screen smart 65 in TV in living room, 55 in TV in loft, and smart TV in all the bedrooms.
Only dog allowed, no other pets! Max. of two (2) dogs. Pet fee $85 per dog.

Guest access
Guest can use the entire house, but not the garage.

Other things to note
The house has three bedrooms upstairs (one with a king bed, one with a queen bed and one with a full bed) 
All the bedrooms are equipped with a Smart TV.
The loft upstairs has a day bed with two singles beds, a foosball table, and a 55-inch 4k smart TV.
